evidence.quote: In my opinion, the root cause of the problems was the underpricing of risk as the financial sector interacted with nonfinancial sectors.

This reasoning suggests that policy actions to treat underlying causes should address the causes of risk mispricing and should attempt to reduce uncertainty.
